title: A Man Fell From 24 Miles Up and Broke the Sound Barrier

scenes.text: A man jumped from 24 miles up and broke the sound barrier with his body.
In 2012, a skydiver rode a balloon to nearly 39 kilometres high, at the edge of space.
Then he stepped out, and fell faster and faster toward the ground.
His top speed was 843 miles an hour. That's Mach 1.25.
The free fall lasted four minutes and nineteen seconds before his parachute opened.
No engine. No wings. Just a person going faster than sound.

description:
In 2012, a skydiver jumped from a balloon 24 miles up and broke the sound barrier in free fall.
He reached 843.6 miles an hour, Mach 1.25, and fell for 4 minutes 19 seconds before opening his parachute. It was the first time a person passed the speed of sound without an engine.
Would you ever jump? Tell us in the comments.
first_comment: He fell for over four minutes. How long do you think you could stay calm in a free fall from the edge of space?
